query: SELECT jsonb_build_object('eventId',d.event_id,'kind',o.kind,'state',d.state,'attempts',d.attempts,'error',d.error,'lastAttemptAt',d.last_attempt_at) AS "delivery!" FROM app_deliveries d JOIN outbox o ON o.tenant=d.tenant AND o.id=d.event_id WHERE d.tenant=$1 AND d.app=$2 ORDER BY d.event_id DESC LIMIT 50
